evidence.title: KONTOGRAPH: Verified Point-in-Time Feature Consistency and Amortised Explanation for Real-Time Anti-Money Laundering under a 200 ms Decision Budget

summary: A new AI model, KONTOGRAPH, ensures verified feature consistency and amortized explanations for real-time AML decisions within a strict 200 ms latency constraint. The breakthrough enhances fraud detection efficiency in financial transactions.
title: AI System Achieves Real-Time Anti-Money Laundering with 200 ms Decision Budget
